name: Forgot password

modules.build: iOS status bar, dark icons for warm-light shell.
Transparent, back chevron '<' with 44px target, top-left aligned.
Headline 'Reset your *password*' (Newsreader italic on password) over body copy 'Enter your email and we'll send reset instructions if it matches.'
Email variant, white fill, warm-gray border 1px #EAE3DC, 16px radius, focus border orange #FF5E00. Placeholder 'email address'. Leading mail glyph. State: default/empty.
Full-width orange #FF5E00 CTA. Copy: 'send reset link'. State: disabled at 40% opacity for invalid/empty input.
iOS home indicator clearance, 134x5px pill bar centered, ink/20 on warm-light shell, bottom-anchored.

belowFold.build: Replaces form on success (crossfade; check scales in 150ms). Green check #34A853. Title 'Check your email'. Body: 'If that email matches an account, reset instructions will arrive.' MaskedDestinationLine + ChipProvenance 'you entered'. BtnPrimary 'Back to sign in'. Label "didn't receive it?" + BtnGhost 'send again' + ChargeMeter '0:47' + ChipProvenance 'system cooldown'.

trustControls: Confirmation copy is account-enumeration safe: 'If that email matches an account, reset instructions will arrive.' — identical framing for known and unknown emails.
MaskedDestinationLine renders only a masked address, never the raw email.
No consent checkbox, source chips, revoke, or export claims on this unauthenticated reset request.
Resend cooldown (ChargeMeter '0:47', ChipProvenance 'system cooldown') is honest-null: hidden entirely before any resend attempt.
notes: Resend cooldown '0:47' renders only after success state, alongside "didn't receive it?" label text.
Form crossfades to confirmation state; reduced-motion swaps instantly and cooldown/check become static text.
Maintain 44px tap targets for back, input, CTA, resend, and support links.
Offline: OfflineBanner appears and submit is disabled with reason; invalid format shows inline error, network failure uses ErrorState with form intact.
